body: Approval needed for exact public vocabulary addition discovered during S1-S4 recovery: OutputTargetIdentity[-Id] with deterministic Checksum and built-in String instance, used to bind universe member and TargetAccount IDs into ReportInputIdentity; context bounds only on report identity, StoryOutputResult.of, and contextual codec decode. Without it, same invocation/source/build plus different generic target IDs can share a report input checksum. Approve this exact addition, or explicitly designate InvocationId as the complete authority and permit target IDs to remain excluded.
